items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: and the one who played the bass, Hobby

ctx.x: There was Bill Kenney and Pete Watson and the one who played the bass, Hobby... And let me see... The guitar player... Yeah, that was the original. Except for Charlie Fuqua. He was the short one... But he wasn't with them. He went in the Army. I don't think he ever come back with them after he come out the Army.
What was his last name again?
